Photoreal live-action, London, March 1881, iron grate, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. At 00:05 Holmes's long hand lifts off the chair arm, and the lift continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is pushing in through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
